scheme_name: Educational Assistance For Children Of Victims Of Crime
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala.
Applicant must be a child or dependent of a crime survivor (victim).
Child must be pursuing education from class 1 onward, with eligibility for degree‑level and higher courses in government or aided institutions, or merit seats in unaided institutions.
If assistance is granted for one year, it can be continued in subsequent years upon certification by the head of the school/college that the child will continue education.
benefits_summary: Provides annual financial assistance ranging from ₹3,000 for classes 1‑5 up to ₹15,000 for PG/M.Phil students.
